'''Card text:'''
Use 2 Force to deploy on any T-47. Use 1 Force to fire. Draw destiny. A character is hit if destiny -1 > ability. A vehicle is hit if destiny +2 > armor or maneuver.

'''Lore:'''
Sund x2-100 laser cannon. Cheap and powerful, so outlaw groups often use it. Frequently fitted to T-47 airspeeders.
